nodes.question: What methods were used to analyze the sediment samples after processing?
nodes.answer: The sediment samples were analyzed for pH, resistivity, various metals, and sediment organic carbon using an inductively coupled plasma atomic emission spectroscopy (ICPMS) instrument.
